name: dsh-image-compare
description: Sidebar image comparer for DeepSeek Harness: browse the session workspace inside the right-column panel, open a set of images into one pageable viewer, zoom and pan each image independently, sync one view onto the whole set, and reorder them by dragging the filmstrip.

comment.runtime: The host half uses the `fs` and `webServer` services to serve two read-only routes; the client half requires only `react`, which every harness shell preloads. Both are supplied by the running profile, so this package deliberately declares NO dependencies: an installed copy must never ship its own copy of a dsh framework package next to the host's.
comment.tests: test/host.test.mjs drives apply() against a stubbed context; test/client.dom.mjs needs react, react-dom and jsdom, installed on demand with `node <pnpm> add -D react@18.2.0 react-dom@18.2.0 jsdom`.
